import mujoco, numpy as np, time

def run(model, seed, nstep):
    d = mujoco.MjData(model)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    d.qpos += rng.normal(0, 0.01, size=d.qpos.shape)
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, d)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(nstep):
        mujoco.mj_step(model, d)
    t1 = time.perf_counter()
    full = mujoco.mjtState.mjSTATE_FULLPHYSICS
    state = np.zeros(mujoco.mj_stateSize(model, full))
    mujoco.mj_getState(model, d, state, full)
    return state, t1-t0

base = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('model_ref.xml')
ref_state, ref_time = run(base, 42, 1000)
print(f'ref: time={ref_time*1000:.2f} ms')

for dt in [0.002, 0.004, 0.008, 0.01]:
    m2 = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('model_ref.xml')
    m2.opt.timestep = dt
    nstep = int(2.0/dt)
    st, t = run(m2, 42, nstep)
    diff = np.linalg.norm(st - ref_state)
    maxd = np.abs(st - ref_state).max()
    ok = np.allclose(st, ref_state, atol=1e-5)
    print(f'dt={dt}: nstep={nstep} time={t*1000:8.2f} ms ratio={t/ref_time:6.3f} normdiff={diff:.3e} maxdiff={maxd:.3e} allclose={ok}')
EOF

# d.mf holds the Cholesky factor (lower triangular, nv x nv)

# check band structure: max distance from diagonal with nonzero
